scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n node1,node2,client -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev:node1" "npm run dev:node2" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.start:redis:wsl: wsl -d Ubuntu -u root sh -lc "apt-get update && apt-get install -y redis-server && redis-server --daemonize yes"
